vision: A self-learning AI research desk: discover, research, score, debate, simulate, dossier, alert, track outcome, and learn.

currentPhase.title: Live Catalyst Radar
currentPhase.objective: Detect why-now events before the normal scoring stack fully reacts.
deliverables: Unlock, listing, launch, airdrop, governance, staking, release, TVL, liquidity, X, and news event detectors
successMetrics: Every high-priority alert includes a catalyst reason
Dashboard shows current catalyst feed
False catalyst rate is reviewed by Outcome Judge

roadmap.title: Live Catalyst Radar
roadmap.objective: Detect why-now events before the normal scoring stack fully reacts.
deliverables: Unlock, listing, launch, airdrop, governance, staking, release, TVL, liquidity, X, and news event detectors
successMetrics: Every high-priority alert includes a catalyst reason
Dashboard shows current catalyst feed
False catalyst rate is reviewed by Outcome Judge

roadmap.title: Real-Time Watchtower Dashboard
roadmap.objective: Turn the public dashboard into a live intelligence surface that people can inspect quickly.
deliverables: Project, chain, narrative, and urgency filters
successMetrics: A visitor can understand the top opportunities in under 60 seconds
Every top candidate links to raw JSON evidence
Dashboard is mobile-readable

roadmap.title: Historical Backtesting Lab
roadmap.objective: Measure which engines, narratives, and regimes actually produced follow-through.
successMetrics: Reports include hit rate and sample size
No high-conviction claim appears without historical context
Weak engines are visible, not hidden

roadmap.title: Agent Learning System v2
roadmap.objective: Make every agent accountable for its calls and dynamically adjust trust.
successMetrics: AI Council displays agent trust weights
Dossier Swarm agents include performance history
Outcome Judge can explain which agents were right

roadmap.title: Deep Internet Research Mode
roadmap.objective: Research projects from official and public sources with citations and freshness scoring.
successMetrics: Every top dossier includes sourced claims
Research age is visible
Unverified claims reduce confidence

roadmap.title: Portfolio Intelligence Layer
roadmap.objective: Move from best-token ranking to portfolio-aware research decisions.
successMetrics: Top opportunities are compared against each other
Dashboard shows concentration risk
Portfolio suggestions include invalidation logic

roadmap.title: Public Product Polish
roadmap.objective: Make the GitHub repo feel polished enough that visitors want to star, fork, and run it.
successMetrics: New users can run the demo without help
README shows real outputs
Repo has clear contribution paths

roadmap.title: Autonomous Research Desk
roadmap.objective: Tie discovery, research, scoring, alerts, outcomes, and learning into one recurring research desk.
successMetrics: The system can run unattended
Every alert is later outcome-graded
Weekly brief explains what changed and why

executionPrinciples: Every high-conviction claim should have evidence, confidence, and invalidation.
Every alert should be outcome-graded later.
Free data sources remain first-class; paid APIs are optional accelerators.
The public demo should always run without keys.
